articles.title: OTF GRIMM one-year anniversary: violence-as-a-service targets published on EU Most Wanted
articles.summary: As the Operational Taskforce (OTF) GRIMM marks its first year of activity, high-value targets linked to ongoing investigations are being published on the EU Most Wanted website. The publication aims to intensify efforts to locate and arrest some of the most dangerous fugitives involved in violence-as-a-service and other forms of serious organised crime.
articles.analysis: La publicación de objetivos de OTF GRIMM en EU Most Wanted tras un año de actividad sugiere limitaciones operativas en la localización de redes de 'violencia como servicio'

articles.summary: Europol has supported a comprehensive investigation conducted by Swiss authorities in collaboration with German law enforcement against members of the international criminal organisation ‘Black Axe’. On 28 April 2026, house searches were carried out in several Swiss cantons, resulting in a total of 10 arrests, including the Black Axe “Regional Head” for the Southern European region. articles.title: Call centres dismantled and ten arrested in EUR 50 million online fraud case
articles.summary: A criminal network operating a large-scale online fraud scheme has been dismantled through a collaborative investigation involving Austrian and Albanian authorities, with support from Europol and Eurojust. The operation, which spanned over two years, resulted in the arrest of ten individuals, the search of multiple premises, and the seizure of nearly EUR 900 000 in cash.
articles.analysis: El desmantelamiento de centros de llamadas fraudulentas por 50 millones revela la industrialización del fraude online, aunque la investigación de dos años sugiere limitaciones en la detección temprana
